summary: SMX (Security Matters) Public Limited Company filed a Form 6-K on May 15, 2026, reporting an amendment to its 2022 Incentive Equity Plan to increase authorized shares from ~237,730 to 696,105 and the subsequent grant of 458,375 restricted stock units (RSUs) to executives, directors, and consultants. The RSUs vest 75% immediately and 25% on December 1, 2026. The amendment was approved without stockholder approval, relying on foreign private issuer exemptions under Nasdaq rules. The filing is a routine equity compensation plan modification and grant disclosure. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special situation is involved.
